from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    best = None
    for line in colors:
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line for v in grid[r]) >= 0.70 * w]
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) >= 0.70 * h]
        # The separator color is the one whose row/column lattice contains
        # the most non-separator vertex marks.
        marks = [(r, c) for r in rows for c in cols if grid[r][c] != line]
        score = len(marks)
        if best is None or score > best[0]:
            best = (score, line, rows, cols, marks)
    score, line, rows, cols, marks = best
    if score == 0 or not rows or not cols:
        raise ValueError('no marked lattice found')
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line).most_common(1)[0][0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in marks), max(r for r, _ in marks)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in marks), max(c for _, c in marks)
    rows = [r for r in rows if r0 <= r <= r1]
    cols = [c for c in cols if c0 <= c <= c1]
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        outrow = []
        for ca, cb in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[ra][ca], grid[ra][cb], grid[rb][ca], grid[rb][cb]]
            outrow.append(corners[0] if all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else fill)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
